children: MongoDB board authorized a $1 billion expansion to its share repurchase program.
The company said Tuesday the boost brings the total authorization for stock buybacks to $2 billion. Around $1.35 billion of that total remains available for share repurchases, the company said.
Write to Elias Schisgall at elias.schisgall@wsj.com
